Class ViewLessonEdit

java.lang.Object
guiLessonEdit.ViewLessonEdit
public final class ViewLessonEdit extends Object
KG03/KG06 editor with explicit full/per-field lock labels. The existing ID is immutable; fields hold the user's draft, and the save button opens only after an authorized read.
